mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_comment (user_id, target_id, target_type, content, rating, images, parent_id, reply_to_user_id, order_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{targetId}, #{targetType}, #{content}, #{rating}, #{images}, #{parentId}, #{replyToUserId}, #{orderId})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, c.content, c.rating, c.images, c.like_count, c.parent_id, c.create_time FROM biz_comment c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 1 AND c.target_id = #{targetId} AND c.target_type = #{targetType} AND c.parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_comment WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND target_id = #{targetId} AND target_type = #{targetType} AND parent_id IS NULL
